purpose.summary: Batch program that generates a medical insurance claim (receipt) billing request document for the Japanese JMA ORCA standard receipt software system, specifically handling new/wide-area combined and diagnosis-treatment billing requests (Shinkyu/Kouiki-Rengou/Shinryo Hoshuu Seikyusho). It reads claim DB update files, accumulates summary totals by public expense (Kouhi) category, and produces formatted output.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance)

notable_features: Part of JMA ORCA open-source Japanese medical receipt software
Heavy use of COPY statements for shared record layouts (CPRCF010.INC, CPPTINF.INC, CPHKNNUM.INC, etc.)
UNSTRING of comma-delimited COMMAND-PARAM for parameter passing
Multi-level OCCURS tables for public expense (Kouhi) billing aggregation
Japanese Shift-JIS / EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1, hence garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based DB update pattern
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256) for shell invocation
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing garbled display. The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the JMA ORCA project (circa 2008–2010). All four COBOL divisions are present. The truncated source shows only the first ~16 KB of an ~88 KB file; the PROCEDURE DIVISION body is largely unseen but the structure is unambiguous.
